market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.2m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: OPEC March 2026 ~1.095m bpd, trending up after sanctions waivers and Chevron deals; April exports already 1.23m. 1.2m production threshold within reach over remaining 8 monthly OPEC reports of 2026. Analyst forecasts target 1.2m by year-end.
assessment.key_uncertainty: US sanctions trajectory and PDVSA operational capacity.
